headline_zh: 16/16 (100.0%) 确定性拦截 x402 入口身份分裂/OPTIONS 误收费、UCP 私有源与 Stripe 重试重复扣款
headline_en: 16/16 (100.0%) Deterministic Guard Across x402 Delivery-Receipt/Ingress-ID, UCP & Stripe Idempotency

scenarios.title_zh: x402 交付收据签名、单次入口身份、PaymentCall 与多链结算合规基线
scenarios.title_en: Compliant x402 Delivery-Receipt, Single-Ingress ID, PaymentCall & Multi-Chain
scenarios.reason: All x402 delivery-receipt, single-ingress identity, PaymentCall, SVM/EVM upto, Cache-Control, and multi-chain checks passed.

scenarios.title_zh: x402 #3738 通配符路由将 `OPTIONS` 预检误判为 402 付费请求阻断
scenarios.title_en: x402 #3738 Wildcard Route Treating `OPTIONS` Preflight as Paid 402 Block
scenarios.reason: Wildcard route matching must never treat OPTIONS CORS preflight as a paid 402 request (#3738).

scenarios.title_zh: x402 #3741 `ResourceInfo` 声明付费 HTTP 方法与实际请求不一致阻断
scenarios.title_en: x402 #3741 `ResourceInfo` Declared Paid HTTP Method Mismatch Block
scenarios.reason: Payment sent on GET but ResourceInfo declares paid method POST (#3741).

scenarios.title_zh: x402 #3776 结算/拒绝/重放查询身份在下游二次派生导致分裂阻断
scenarios.title_en: x402 #3776 Downstream Re-Derivation of Settlement/Replay Identity Block
scenarios.reason: Settlement/refusal/replay/quote identity MUST be derived once at ingress and never re-derived (#3776).

scenarios.title_zh: x402 #3775 畸形 `PaymentCall` 在签名前 fail-closed 阻断
scenarios.reason: MCP PaymentCall requires toolName and arguments mapping (#3775).

scenarios.title_zh: x402 #3783 `delivery-receipt` 引用模式超出 1KB 头部预算或域前缀缺失阻断
scenarios.title_en: x402 #3783 `delivery-receipt` >1KB Reference Header or Prefix Mismatch Block
scenarios.reason: delivery-receipt requires 'x402-delivery-receipt/1\n' || receiptId and <= 1 KB reference header (#3783).

scenarios.title_zh: x402 #3784 SVM 链上已确认执行失败被误标为 `settlement_pending` 阻断
scenarios.title_en: x402 #3784 Confirmed SVM On-Chain Execution Error Marked Pending Block
scenarios.reason: Confirmed SVM transaction with status.Err must be reported as terminal failure, not settlement_pending (#3784).

scenarios.title_zh: x402 #3769 EVM `settleUptoPermit2` 按上限而非实际结算额模拟导致误拒阻断
scenarios.title_en: x402 #3769 EVM `settleUptoPermit2` Simulating Full Ceiling Instead of Settlement Block
scenarios.reason: settleUptoPermit2 must simulate with settlementAmount rather than signed ceiling (#3769).

scenarios.title_zh: x402 #3757/#3752/#3737 引号内 `private` 误判或 Hedera 重编码/BIP-122 确认深度不足阻断
scenarios.title_en: x402 #3757/#3752/#3737 Quoted `private` Bypass or Hedera/BIP-122 Depth Block
scenarios.reason: withPrivateCacheControl must ignore 'private' inside quoted strings and append unquoted private (#3757).

scenarios.title_zh: UCP `payment.terms` 规范 ID、公网 Lockfile 源、签名 `ucp-agent` 覆盖与 Location 头基线
scenarios.title_en: Compliant UCP `payment.terms` ID, Public Lockfiles, `ucp-agent` Coverage & Location Headers
scenarios.reason: UCP payment.terms capability ID, public lockfile registries, ucp-agent signature coverage, and Location headers verified.

scenarios.title_zh: UCP #818 错误引用不存在的 `dev.ucp.common.payment.payment_terms` 阻断
scenarios.reason: Payment terms capability ID must be 'dev.ucp.common.payment.terms', not 'dev.ucp.common.payment.payment_terms' (#818).

scenarios.title_zh: UCP #806 Lockfile 混入企业私有制品源（CodeArtifact/Azure/GAR/Shopify）阻断
scenarios.title_en: UCP #806 Corporate Private Package Registry in Lockfile Block
scenarios.reason: Corporate or non-public registry URL 'https://corp.d.codeartifact.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/npm/' is blocked in lockfiles (#806).

scenarios.title_zh: UCP #795/#784 携带 `UCP-Agent` 却未纳入 RFC 9421 签名覆盖组件阻断
scenarios.title_en: UCP #795/#784 Missing `ucp-agent` in RFC 9421 Covered Components Block
scenarios.reason: Checkout REST signature must cover 'ucp-agent' when UCP-Agent header is present (#795).

scenarios.title_zh: Stripe 多 Agent 权属与跨调用幂等键、分页游标及 MCP SEP-3371/2133 合规基线
scenarios.title_en: Compliant Stripe Agent Identity, Cross-Retry Idempotency, Pagination & MCP SEP-3371
scenarios.reason: Stripe agent identity, cross-invocation idempotency, pagination, and MCP SEP-3371/2133 extension points verified.

scenarios.title_zh: Stripe AI #419/#453 跨调用重试生成新随机幂等键导致重复扣款阻断
scenarios.title_en: Stripe AI #419/#453 Cross-Invocation Retry Regenerating Random Idempotency Key Block
scenarios.reason: Agent retries across invocations must use deterministic idempotency keys and list tools must support starting_after (#419).

scenarios.title_zh: MCP #3371/#3364 扩展注册依赖顺序耦合或 `2025-11-25` 缺失 `initialize` 协商阻断
scenarios.title_en: MCP #3371/#3364 Order-Dependent Extension Registration or `2025-11-25` Negotiation Block
scenarios.reason: SEP-3371 requires order-independent extension registration and 2025-11-25 requires initialize-based negotiation (#3371/#3364).
